svg.text: Nokta Academy — Complete Chen Entity-Relationship Diagram
Green rectangles = entities/collections • Pink ovals = attributes • Blue diamonds = relationships • Underlined labels = primary or unique keys • ? = optional • [] = multi-valued
All base-schema entities additionally contain _id:ObjectId (PK), createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted, deletedAt, and deletedBy?→User. MongoDB references are application-level, not enforced foreign keys.
Relationship catalogue — every declared ObjectId reference
